profile.headline: AIML Software Engineer at Apple

positions.title: Lead iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Lead a mid-size team for the development of the flagship iPhone/iPad app for Match.com. Built and provided design direction for our universal app, extensions, API, and reusable SDKs. Built the Apple Watch experience for the Match.com app. Setup and maintained continuous integration process and managed app deployment through Ad Hoc, Enterprise and App Store provisioning.

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/match-dating-app-to-flirt/id305939712?mt=8

positions.title: Staff Architect
positions.description:
Provided design direction for Android & iOS apps as part of a video anywhere platform utilized by NBC Universal and Scripps Networks (Food Network, HGTV). 
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/nbc/id442839435?mt=8

iOS Technical Lead on McKinsey Insights app for iPad.
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/mckinsey-insights/id674902075?mt=8

Development experience with iOS focusing on the Objective-C runtime, Grand Central Dispatch, Core Image, Core Motion, Deep Linking, Autolayout, static libraries, API consumption, migration to Swift, Inversion of Control, and Unit Testing.

positions.title: Platform Architect
positions.description: Designed and implemented a daily fantasy sports platform using a mobile first approach consisting of a central API with desktop web, mobile web and iPhone app clients using Windows Azure cloud hosting. Built out a development and deployment workflow utilizing Github for source control and code reviews, Team Foundation Service for Agile work planning, TeamCity and Octopus Deploy for continuous integration. Platform was built on SQL Azure, Redis, C# WebAPI, C# Windows Services, BackboneJS/Marionette, Handlebars, and SignalR. Redis was used extensively for database deflection, leaderboard scoring, and realtime communication using Pub/Sub, also utilized Redis Sentinel for clustering and failover.

positions.title: Director of Product Development, Leasing Desk
positions.description: Lead domestic and off-shore development teams in the development of two major products, including both public facing (B2C) and client facing (B2B) software as a service applications. Lead the transition of teams from a Waterfall methodology to Agile. Lead the introduction of a TFS based Development workflow and all services to manage integration with an existing Waterfall centric release management system. Worked closely with the Director of Product to implement the needs of various external stakeholders.

positions.title: Architect
positions.description: Lead the implementation of numerous major product initiatives for the Match.com public website. Provide architectural guidance and platform design for the full stack of the public website and supporting backend services. Provide UI engineering guidance and consult on design principles and usability. Work daily to balance a fast paced iterative development environment with the demands of a highly scalable website, as well as preserve product quality through careful change management. Entrusted with the application stack of Match's core business.

positions.title: Senior Application Engineer
positions.description: Self taught on LAMP stack and Facebook API. Built a Facebook application using Red Hat Linux, Apache, MySQL, MySQL. Also built front-end relying heavily on HTML, FBHTML (useful at the time), CSS and Javascript.

projects.title: Yahoo! Personals Acquisition and Merger
projects.description: Yahoo! Personals M&A by Match.com. Included full user migration, UX during transition and long term UX experience to continue to serve the Y! Personals member base with a superior dating experience on Match.com.  Also included a cobranded Match.com on Y! site.

allTitles: Director of Product Development, Leasing Desk
